scenarios.title: Title screen shows Taoist/ModLib buttons and versions are compatible
scenarios.description: Smoke test of the mod installation. On the title screen Taoist adds its own buttons (Taoist version, S&M configs) and ModLib adds its buttons. If they are missing the mods did not load; if ModLib is older than the version Taoist needs, a warning would appear. Passes when all buttons are there and no warning is shown.

No 'not supported in ModLib' warning (ModLib >= MODLIB_REQUIRED_VERSION)

scenarios.title: S&M configs window: 3 pages, presets and cancel

Page 3 holds the toggles of the additional features (encounters, bank loans, buy orders, bounties); they do not change the difficulty score.
steps: Look at page 1, go to page 2
expected: Valid saved values (GrowUpSpeed >= 1, NPCAmount > 0, StartupPlayerRole in range)

The global config file is written.

scenarios.title: Error reports to BugSplat only with the player's consent
scenarios.description: ModLib can send the errors of a mod to that mod's BugSplat database (its ModConf/crash_reports.json), but only after the player said yes in a dialog that lists the mods and tells what is sent; an answer given for an older consent text or other mods is not used. A local stand-in of BugSplat (127.0.0.1) records every request the game makes: nothing before the answer or after 'No'; after 'Yes' the 3 requests of the BugSplat protocol for Taoist (the mod of the error: app name and version of Taoist, modId) with a zip of Callstack.txt and log.txt (last log lines, cut, user folder and Windows account removed), commit with crash type, ETag, anonymous id, attributes; nothing private (Windows account, game data path), and the same error only once. Evidence: screenshots of the dialog, of the captured requests and of the ModCreator row, plus <run folder>/bugsplat/ (requests.json, uploaded zip, Callstack.txt, commit form). With the environment variable BUGSPLAT_TEST_DB set before the run, one real report is also sent to that BugSplat database. The player's answer and the settings are restored.
steps: Set a test database and the stand-in server; log an error before any answer
Open the consent dialog, answer No, log an error
Open the consent dialog again, answer Yes, log an error
Check the requests received; show them; log the same error again
expected: No request before the answer and after No
An answer for another consent key is not used (asked again)

After Yes: GET upload url (Taoist name and version), PUT zip (Callstack.txt + log.txt without private values), POST commit with crashTypeId 18, md5 = ETag, anonymous user id, attributes with modId of Taoist
Nothing private sent; the same error sent once
ModCreator window shows 'Error reports' with the answer
Real upload accepted (when BUGSPLAT_TEST_DB is set)

scenarios.title: Exception dialog says whether the error was sent to BugSplat
scenarios.description: When an error opens the exception dialog, a red note at the bottom of the dialog, centered above the buttons (as the note of the S&M configs), tells the player what happened to it: sent to the mod author (BugSplat) when the player allowed error reports (also for the same error again, already sent this session), otherwise 'not sent, report it with the log to the author of the mod' without any link (ModLib is used by many mod authors). Uploads go to the local stand-in BugSplat server of TT-06. The player's answer and the settings are restored.
steps: Player answered No: log an error with the exception dialog on
Player answered Yes: log an error, wait for the upload
No mod with a BugSplat database: log an error
expected: No: red note 'not sent' at the bottom (centered, above the buttons), no link, nothing uploaded
Yes: red note 'reported' at the bottom, the error is uploaded
Same error: 'reported' note, no new upload
